goal: Build a small persistent key-value store as a Python package kv/ (standard library only). Module kv/store.py: class Store(path) opens or creates an append-only log file at path. Methods: put(key: str, value: str), get(key) -> str | None, delete(key) (no error if missing), keys(prefix='') -> sorted list of live keys starting with prefix, and close(). Every put and delete is appended to the log as one JSON object per line and flushed before the method returns, so a new Store(path) on the same file sees all earlier writes. A truncated or invalid last line (from a crash mid-write) is ignored on open; an invalid line anywhere else raises ValueError naming the 1-based line number. Store.compact() rewrites the log to hold exactly one put per live key, atomically (write a temp file in the same directory, then os.replace). Module kv/query.py: execute(store, line) -> str runs one command: 'SET key value' (value is the rest of the line, may contain spaces) returns 'OK'; 'GET key' returns the value or '(nil)'; 'DEL key' returns 'OK'; 'KEYS' or 'KEYS prefix' returns the keys one per line (empty string if none); 'COMPACT' returns 'OK'. Commands are case-insensitive, keys are case-sensitive. An unknown command or a wrong number of arguments raises ValueError. Module kv/__main__.py: python -m kv DBFILE runs each line of stdin through execute and prints each result on its own line; on ValueError it prints 'ERR <message>' and continues; exit status 0. Include a pytest suite.
constraints: Package directory kv/ at the project root
